{{Quote|Hey! I got an idea! Let's hide Tantos, okay? I bet we could string him out an airlock at the end of a rope and they'd never find him!''"<br />"''Gah. Kids. I'm not being strung up like a yoyo, y'hear?|[[Jill Farseeker]] and [[Tantos Dree]]|<ref name="RPG">[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'']]</ref>}}
A '''yoyo''' was a device that was connected to a rope. When [[Jill Farseeker]] suggested suspending the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Tantos Dree]] out of the [[Airlock/Legends|airlock]] of the ''[[Dorion Discus]]'' to hide him from [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces, Dree shot the idea down as he disliked the idea of being a strung out like a yoyo.<ref name="RPG" />

{{Noncanonstart|legends=1}}
A [[Unidentified sentient creature|sentient being]] once expressed a desire to play with a baby [[Ack-platt]] like a yoyo.<ref name="MA">''[[Monsters and Aliens from George Lucas]]''</ref>
{{Noncanonend}}
